scope: Preregistered local simulator defensive confirmation, no live-opponent or promotion claim.

design.panel_means: Equal numbers of deals per scripted background, not a real-world opponent distribution. Established and guard panels reported separately.
design.ci_notes: ci95 paired normal; conservative_ci95 Bonferroni difference of Wilson97.5% intervals. Exact McNemar uses integer binomial tails. Repeated deals across profiles/timings are not extra independent samples.

rate_definitions.direct_guard_effect: candidate=guarded source, reference=pre-guard source with same profile
rate_definitions.repeat_minus_one_accusation: candidate=five repeated accusations, reference=one accusation with same source/profile/deal

archive_origin.purpose: Pre-guard strategy counterfactual, extracted with git archive; production source is unchanged from base.
archive_origin.notes: Overlays only register fresh guard seed bank and observation-only guard opponents. Raw manifests hash all source, including overlays. Paired comparisons additionally require identical deals and champion outcomes.

direct_guard_effect.method: Bonferroni two-sided exact McNemar, all enumerated role/opponent slices; exploratory, separate from unchanged promotion gates.

repeat_minus_once.method: Bonferroni two-sided exact McNemar, all enumerated role/opponent slices; exploratory, separate from unchanged promotion gates.

profile_effect_after.method: Bonferroni two-sided exact McNemar, all enumerated role/opponent slices; exploratory, separate from unchanged promotion gates.
